answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 4928 Country: India Title: assalam walekum jawal ke wakt ke kitne time bad " ajan aur jamat " ho sakti hai Question: assalam walekum jawal ke wakt ke kitne time bad " ajan aur jamat " ho sakti hai Answer ID: 4928 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 388/388=M-1429) The sun takes very little time for zawal. Actually, it is undesirable to perform salah exactly in midday time which is a very short time, avoiding salah for ten minutes is enough i.e. one should stop azan and slalah five minutes before and after midday time each. Azan can be called five minutes after midday time and salah also can also be offered with jamat . However, one must pray salah with jamat in mustahab timing. کما فی الدر: وكره تحريما صلاة مع شروق واستواء وغروب الخ ۔۔۔۔۔۔۔۔ ولايخفي أن زوال الشمس إنما هو عقيب انتصاف النهار بلا فصل الخ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
